title: Wider or Deeper? Scaling LLM Inference-Time Compute with Adaptive Branching Tree Search
authors_zh: Yuichi Inoue、Kou Misaki、Yuki Imajuku、So Kuroki、Taishi Nakamura、Takuya Akiba
paper_type_zh: 自适应分支测试时树搜索配方与推理计算扩展研究
best_for_zh: 研究测试时计算、搜索轨迹数据、外部反馈分配、响应修订谱系、预算归因与原始树发布审计的读者
one_line: AB-MCTS allocates a fixed inference budget between fresh response branches and feedback-conditioned revisions, producing scored answer trees that released code can persist even though the paper's realized trees are not public.
AB-MCTS 在固定推理预算下，自适应选择生成新回答分支或沿既有回答进行反馈驱动修订，形成带外部评分的响应—修订树；公开代码可保存完整本地树和逐调用日志，但论文实验的原始树、全部回答、未选分支与 API 日志并未发布。
why: It turns test-time compute into an auditable trace schema—prompts, candidate answers, revisions, scores, tree edges, and budgets—while showing why open algorithms alone are insufficient without raw trees, rejected branches, evaluator context, and stable API revisions.
inclusion_reason: AB-MCTS makes inference-time scaling an explicit response/revision-tree construction problem with budgeted widen/deepen actions and external environment feedback, while clearly exposing the audit gap between a released search recipe and unreleased realized search traces.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Inference-time scaling is often summarized as “sample more answers” or “refine one answer longer,” but a fixed generation budget creates a concrete allocation problem: should the next model call make the response tree wider with a fresh candidate, or deeper by revising an existing answer after feedback? Fixed-width search chooses this tradeoff in advance and can waste calls either on redundant siblings or on repeated repair of an unpromising branch.

Adaptive Branching Monte Carlo Tree Search (AB-MCTS) turns that allocation decision into the search object. The root stores the task prompt. Every non-root node is one complete, scoreable Python solution or ML-engineering program. A wide move produces a fresh answer from a selected node through its GEN option; a deep move follows an existing answer and generates a child revision conditioned on the prior response and evaluator feedback. The resulting data object is not a single chain but a response–revision tree containing candidates, parent/child lineage, generation order, model identity, external evaluation results, node scores, visit/value statistics, and a final selected answer.

Feedback is task dependent. CodeContest and LiveCodeBench use the fraction of public tests passed during search and hidden tests for final evaluation. ARC scores how many demonstration transformations a generated Python program solves, then checks held-out test outputs by exact match. MLE-Bench uses an 80/20 training/validation split for search-time metrics and a hidden test set for final evaluation. These signals are programmatic or environmental surrogates; they do not verify intermediate reasoning and need not agree with hidden-test success.

This work belongs exactly in Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data because response generation, revision, tree topology, external feedback, and budget allocation jointly define the trace. It is an inference-time construction and evaluation recipe, not evidence of SFT, distillation, preference learning, reward-model training, or RLVR. The Card reaches L4 because the paper, appendices, official supplemental code, TreeQuest, and the ARC-AGI-2 repository support a detailed bilingual account. L4 does not imply that the realized experimental trees or logs are public: the release provides executable machinery, not a reusable corpus of paper-run traces.

测试时计算扩展常被概括为“多采样几个答案”或“把一个答案继续改深”，但固定生成预算带来一个具体分配问题：下一次模型调用应通过全新候选让响应树变宽，还是利用反馈修订已有回答、让树变深？固定宽度搜索预先决定这一取舍，可能把调用浪费在重复的同级候选上，也可能反复修补一个没有前景的分支。

Adaptive Branching Monte Carlo Tree Search（AB-MCTS）把这项预算分配决定本身变成搜索对象。根节点保存任务提示；每个非根节点都是一份完整、可评分的 Python 解决方案或 ML-engineering 程序。变宽操作通过选定节点的 GEN 选项生成新回答；变深操作沿已有回答向下，在先前回答和 evaluator 反馈的条件下生成子修订。由此得到的数据对象不是单链，而是一棵响应—修订树，其中可包含候选回答、父子谱系、生成顺序、模型身份、外部评估结果、节点分数、访问/价值统计和最终选中答案。

反馈随任务而异。CodeContest 与 LiveCodeBench 在搜索时使用公开测试通过比例，在最终评估时使用隐藏测试。ARC 根据生成的 Python 程序正确处理多少 demonstration transformation 来评分，再对未见测试输出做精确匹配。MLE-Bench 使用 80/20 训练/验证切分提供搜索指标，并在隐藏测试集上做最终评估。这些信号是程序化或环境式代理；它们不验证中间推理，也不保证与隐藏测试成功一致。

该工作准确归入 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，因为回答生成、修订、树拓扑、外部反馈和预算分配共同定义轨迹。它是推理时构造与评估配方，不是 SFT、蒸馏、偏好学习、奖励模型训练或 RLVR 的证据。本 Card 达到 L4，是因为论文、附录、官方 supplemental code、TreeQuest 和 ARC-AGI-2 仓库足以支持细致的双语说明。L4 不表示实验中实际生成的树或日志已公开：发布物提供可执行机制，而不是可复用的论文运行轨迹语料。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core contribution is an adaptive controller over two uses of the next generation call: widen by sampling a new answer, or deepen by refining an existing response with feedback. Rather than fixing a branching factor, AB-MCTS represents the option to generate a new branch as a GEN child and uses Thompson sampling over posterior predictive score distributions to compare that option with existing responses and refinement paths.

One expansion produces one complete answer node and immediately evaluates it; there is no separate stochastic rollout phase after expansion. The prompt root is only a container, so after \(n\) expansion iterations the tree contains the root plus \(n\) generated nodes. Root children are independent answers to the task. A non-root child is a revision whose prompt includes the original task, its ancestor response, and feedback derived from that response’s evaluation. Tree depth therefore has a semantic meaning: it records successive feedback-conditioned response revision, while width records alternative attempts.

The paper develops two Bayesian variants. AB-MCTS-M treats new branches and existing subtrees through a mixed model. AB-MCTS-A aggregates evidence at nodes and uses conjugate Gaussian or Beta models, depending on the reward setting. Both use sampled posterior predictions to balance exploitation of high-scoring answer regions against exploration through GEN. Backed-up values guide later traversal; the external evaluator, not the language model alone, supplies the scalar evidence.

The released implementation gives this abstract tree a potentially rich trace contract. MCTSResult.save() can pickle the root and every recursively reachable Node; nodes retain parent and child relationships, prompt, completion, evaluation results, model name, visits, and values. OpenAI-compatible generation code can also write request/response logs plus token and price usage. With both artifacts retained, a deep path becomes an auditable sequence of prior answer, evaluator feedback, revision request, new answer, and score.

That capability must be separated from actual release completeness. The official supplemental ZIP and public repositories contain algorithms, task adapters, visualization, checkpoint/resume, and ask–tell interfaces, but not the realized paper-run trees, all generated responses, score histories, unselected branches, or API logs. The contribution is therefore a reproducible search substrate and trace schema, not a public response-tree dataset.

核心贡献是对下一次生成调用的两种用途进行自适应控制：通过采样新答案来变宽，或利用反馈修订已有回答来变深。AB-MCTS 不预设固定 branching factor，而是把生成新分支的可能性表示为 GEN 子节点，并用后验预测分数分布上的 Thompson sampling，将该选项同已有回答及其修订路径进行比较。

一次 expansion 生成一个完整答案节点并立即评估；扩展之后没有独立的随机 rollout 阶段。提示根节点只是容器，因此经过 \(n\) 次扩展后，树包含根节点和 \(n\) 个生成节点。根节点的子节点是对任务的独立回答；非根子节点则是修订，其请求包含原始任务、祖先回答和由该回答评估结果构造的反馈。因此，树深具有明确语义：它记录连续的反馈驱动响应修订；树宽则记录不同尝试。

论文提出两种 Bayesian 变体。AB-MCTS-M 通过 mixed model 处理新分支与已有子树；AB-MCTS-A 在节点上聚合证据，并根据 reward 设置使用共轭 Gaussian 或 Beta 模型。二者都对后验预测进行采样，以在利用高分回答区域和通过 GEN 探索之间取得平衡。回传价值引导后续遍历；标量证据来自外部 evaluator，而不是仅由语言模型自评。

公开实现使这棵抽象树具备丰富轨迹契约的潜力。MCTSResult.save() 可以 pickle 根节点及所有递归可达的 Node；节点保留父子关系、prompt、completion、评估结果、模型名、访问次数和价值。OpenAI-compatible 生成代码还可写入请求/响应日志以及 token 与价格用量。若两类 artifact 均被保留，一条深路径就能成为可审计的“先前回答—evaluator 反馈—修订请求—新回答—分数”序列。

必须把这种能力同实际发布完整性区分开。官方 supplemental ZIP 与公开仓库包含算法、任务适配器、可视化、checkpoint/resume 和 ask–tell 接口，却不包含论文运行中实际生成的树、全部回答、分数历史、未选分支或 API 日志。因此，该贡献是可复现的搜索 substrate 与轨迹 schema，而不是公开的响应树数据集。

title: Method
方法
html:
Task inputs and answer objects. Main experiments cover CodeContest, LiveCodeBench release-v4 problems dated August–November 2024, 100 public ARC-AGI evaluation problems, and three low-complexity MLE-Bench tasks derived from Kaggle. The extended study uses the 120-task public ARC-AGI-2 evaluation set. Every generated non-root node is a complete Python answer or ML-engineering program, rather than a labeled intermediate reasoning step.

Generation and revision. AB-MCTS starts with the task prompt at the root. At each iteration it selects through the current tree, chooses between a GEN option and an existing response/subtree using Thompson sampling, generates one complete answer, scores it, and backs the result up. Selecting GEN makes a fresh branch. Traversing through an existing answer eventually creates a child revision; the supplemental solver constructs its request from the task, the previous assistant generation, and feedback derived from evaluation results. This is the operational widen/deepen response-revision contract.

Search models. AB-MCTS-M uses a mixed model for adaptive branching; AB-MCTS-A uses aggregated node statistics with conjugate Gaussian or Beta models. The checked algorithm and Node/MCTSResult implementation expose no explicit branch pruning or deletion path. “Rejected” means not chosen as the final answer, not erased during generation. All nodes can remain in the local serialized tree, and final submission code ranks nodes and selects the first highest-ranked candidate containing valid Python code. Hidden tests are not used as the search score.

Evaluators and terminal use. CodeContest and LiveCodeBench score the fraction of public tests passed. ARC scores the fraction of demonstration examples transformed correctly. MLE-Bench uses task-specific validation metrics, with each candidate executed on one H100 under a one-hour limit. Final evaluation uses hidden code tests, held-out ARC exact outputs, or hidden MLE tests. ARC-AGI-2 also reports Pass@k discovery—whether any branch found an exact solution—separately from contest-style Pass@2 selection. These contracts mix programmatic execution with task environments and can create search-feedback/final-evaluation mismatch.

Models, sampling, and repeated runs. The main model settings are GPT-4o gpt-4o-2024-08-06 at temperature 0.6 and DeepSeek-V3 through the mutable deepseek-chat alias at temperature 1.0. LiveCodeBench uses five repetitions, CodeContest and ARC-AGI three, and MLE-Bench one. The ARC-AGI-2 extension uses gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06, o4-mini-2025-04-16, and deepseek-r1-0528, all at temperature 0.6. No teacher model or post-training optimizer is disclosed because the procedure is inference-time search.

Budgets and accounting. The main maximum is 128 LLM generation/API calls per task, or \(2^7\) added answer nodes. Standard MCTS generates five children per expansion and uses three on its final expansion so that its comparison also totals exactly 128 calls. Appendix ARC-AGI analyses extend to \(2^9=512\) nodes. The later ARC-AGI-2 multi-model experiment uses 250 generation calls, not 128. Call count is only a nominal budget: it omits generated tokens, evaluator runtime, retries, wall-clock latency, provider price, and MLE GPU cost.

Persistence and release. The NeurIPS supplemental code can save the full reachable tree through MCTSResult, and its OpenAI-compatible client can preserve request-plus-generation responses and usage logs. TreeQuest adds multi-model search, visualization, checkpoint/resume, and ask–tell APIs. These are local capabilities. The supplemental logging directories contain no realized experiment outputs, the repositories do not commit a paper-run trace corpus, and artifacts.data and artifacts.huggingface therefore remain null.

任务输入与答案对象。 主实验覆盖 CodeContest、LiveCodeBench release-v4 中 2024 年 8–11 月的问题、100 个公开 ARC-AGI evaluation problems，以及三个源自 Kaggle 的低复杂度 MLE-Bench 任务。扩展研究使用 120 个任务的公开 ARC-AGI-2 evaluation set。每个生成的非根节点都是完整 Python 答案或 ML-engineering 程序，而不是带标签的中间推理步骤。

生成与修订。 AB-MCTS 以任务提示作为根节点。每次迭代在当前树中选择路径，使用 Thompson sampling 在 GEN 选项和已有回答/子树之间决策，生成一个完整答案，对其评分，再回传结果。选择 GEN 会产生新分支；沿已有回答遍历最终会生成子修订，supplemental solver 从任务、先前 assistant generation 和评估结果构造的反馈中组装修订请求。这就是变宽/变深响应—修订契约的实际操作。

搜索模型。 AB-MCTS-M 用 mixed model 实现自适应分支；AB-MCTS-A 用聚合节点统计与共轭 Gaussian 或 Beta 模型。已检查的算法以及 Node/MCTSResult 实现中没有明确的分支剪枝或删除路径。“被拒绝”指没有成为最终答案，而不是在生成期间被抹除。所有节点都可以保留在本地序列化树中；最终提交代码对节点排序，并选择排名最高且包含有效 Python 代码的候选。隐藏测试不用于搜索评分。

Evaluator 与终点使用。 CodeContest 和 LiveCodeBench 使用公开测试通过比例评分；ARC 使用正确完成的 demonstration example 比例；MLE-Bench 使用任务特定 validation metric，每个候选在一张 H100 上执行，时限一小时。最终评估使用隐藏代码测试、未见 ARC 精确输出或隐藏 MLE 测试。ARC-AGI-2 还把 Pass@k discovery（任意分支是否找到精确解）与竞赛式 Pass@2 selection 分开报告。这些契约结合程序执行与任务环境，可能产生搜索反馈与最终评估不一致。

模型、采样与重复运行。 主设置为 GPT-4o gpt-4o-2024-08-06、temperature 0.6，以及通过可变 deepseek-chat alias 调用的 DeepSeek-V3、temperature 1.0。LiveCodeBench 重复五次，CodeContest 与 ARC-AGI 重复三次，MLE-Bench 一次。ARC-AGI-2 扩展使用 gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06、o4-mini-2025-04-16 和 deepseek-r1-0528，temperature 均为 0.6。流程属于推理时搜索，因此没有披露 teacher model 或后训练 optimizer。

预算与计量。 主实验每个任务最多 128 次 LLM generation/API call，即 \(2^7\) 个新增答案节点。Standard MCTS 每次扩展生成五个子节点，最后一次只生成三个，使比较总数也恰好为 128 次调用。附录 ARC-AGI 分析扩展至 \(2^9=512\) 个节点。较后的 ARC-AGI-2 多模型实验使用 250 次生成调用，而不是 128 次。调用数只是名义预算：它不包含生成 token、evaluator 运行时间、重试、墙钟延迟、provider 价格或 MLE GPU 成本。

持久化与发布。 NeurIPS supplemental code 可通过 MCTSResult 保存完整可达树，其 OpenAI-compatible client 还可保存请求与生成响应以及用量日志。TreeQuest 另提供多模型搜索、可视化、checkpoint/resume 和 ask–tell API。这些都是本地能力。supplemental logging 目录中没有实际实验输出，公开仓库也未提交论文运行轨迹语料，因此 artifacts.data 与 artifacts.huggingface 必须保持 null。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
What the paper demonstrates. Across CodeContest, LiveCodeBench, ARC-AGI, and MLE-Bench, the paper compares adaptive branching against single-response refinement, repeated independent sampling, and standard MCTS under generation budgets that grow mainly to 128 calls. Its reported benchmark curves support the narrower claim that dynamically reallocating calls between new attempts and revisions can improve task success under the tested models, evaluators, and budgets. The width/depth analyses and complete illustrated trees up to node 128 show that AB-MCTS changes search geometry rather than merely returning more independent answers.

What the extended study demonstrates. ARC-AGI analyses explore budgets up to 512 nodes, and the ARC-AGI-2 extension uses 250 calls with three precisely named model snapshots. It reports discovery-oriented Pass@k as well as final-selection measures. This distinguishes the ability of a tree to contain a correct branch from the ability of the selection rule to submit the correct answer. The 250-call result must not be reported as part of the main 128-call protocol.

What the implementation verifies. The official supplemental code supplies stronger evidence about the trace object than aggregate benchmark tables alone. MCTSResult.save() serializes the root and recursively reachable nodes; Node records expose parent/child topology, prompt, completion, evaluation result, model name, visits, and values. The solver’s revision prompt contains the prior generation and evaluator-derived feedback. OpenAI-compatible calls can log request/response payloads and token/price usage. Thus the published recipe is technically capable of retaining the complete answer tree, all locally generated alternatives, revision lineage, and scoring context.

What is not demonstrated or released. No public experiment corpus contains those serialized trees or per-call logs. The supplemental logging directories are empty, TreeQuest publishes tooling rather than paper-run outputs, and the ARC-AGI-2 repository says newly generated logs appear under outputs/ without committing the realized outputs. Figures and aggregate tables do not substitute for machine-readable nodes, all responses, unselected branches, evaluator histories, or generation order. No explicit pruning path was found, so locally unselected nodes can remain recoverable; however, their absence from the public release prevents direct verification of this behavior on the reported runs.

Benchmark improvements are not evidence that the generated trace data are unbiased, licensed for reuse, decontaminated, or independently reproduced. The evidence supports an inference-time search method and an implementable trace contract. It does not support claims of a released dataset, step-level correctness, semantic faithfulness, training effectiveness, or universal superiority across evaluators and cost models.

论文证明了什么。 论文在 CodeContest、LiveCodeBench、ARC-AGI 和 MLE-Bench 上，将自适应分支同单回答修订、重复独立采样和 standard MCTS 比较，生成预算主要扩展到 128 次调用。其 benchmark 曲线支持一个较窄结论：在已测试模型、evaluator 与预算下，把调用动态分配给新尝试和修订可以提高任务成功率。宽度/深度分析以及展示至第 128 个节点的完整示例树说明，AB-MCTS 改变的是搜索几何，而不仅是返回更多独立答案。

扩展研究证明了什么。 ARC-AGI 分析探索至 512 个节点，ARC-AGI-2 扩展则用三个精确命名的模型快照和 250 次调用。它同时报告面向发现的 Pass@k 与最终选择指标，从而把“树中是否包含正确分支”同“选择规则是否提交正确答案”区分开。250 次调用结果不能被写成主实验 128 次调用协议的一部分。

实现核验了什么。 官方 supplemental code 对轨迹对象提供了比汇总 benchmark 表格更强的证据。MCTSResult.save() 序列化根节点及所有递归可达节点；Node 记录暴露父子拓扑、prompt、completion、评估结果、模型名、访问次数和价值。solver 的修订提示包含先前生成内容与 evaluator 产生的反馈。OpenAI-compatible 调用还能记录请求/响应 payload 以及 token/价格用量。因此，发布的配方在技术上能够保留完整答案树、本地生成的全部替代项、修订谱系和评分上下文。

什么没有被证明或发布。 公开实验语料中没有这些序列化树或逐调用日志。supplemental logging 目录为空，TreeQuest 发布的是工具而非论文运行输出；ARC-AGI-2 仓库说明新生成日志会出现在 outputs/，但未提交实际输出。图表与汇总表不能替代机器可读节点、全部回答、未选分支、evaluator 历史或生成顺序。已检查实现中未发现显式剪枝路径，因此本地未选节点可以继续可恢复；但公共发布缺失这些对象，使读者无法直接验证论文运行是否如此。

Benchmark 提升不是生成轨迹数据无偏、具备复用许可、完成去污染或已被独立复现的证据。现有证据支持一套推理时搜索方法和可实现的轨迹契约，但不支持“已发布数据集”、步骤级正确性、语义忠实性、训练有效性或跨 evaluator/成本模型普遍更优等主张。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
AB-MCTS changes the branching decision from a fixed search hyperparameter into an online allocation problem. Independent best-of-\(N\) sampling spends every call on width. Iterative refinement spends calls on depth. Standard fixed-branching MCTS predetermines how many children expansion creates. AB-MCTS instead keeps a GEN option in competition with existing answer paths and lets Bayesian Thompson sampling decide whether the next call should open a new response or revise a prior one.

The response-tree representation is equally important for reasoning-data analysis. A non-root edge is not merely an abstract search transition: it links a complete answer to a new complete answer generated from the task, the prior response, and evaluator feedback. The tree can therefore encode alternative attempts and explicit revision lineage in one object. The separation between tree width and revision depth makes allocation policy, generation budget, evaluator result, and final selection inspectable at the node level when local artifacts are retained.

The two variants make different modeling choices rather than introducing new sources of supervision. AB-MCTS-M models adaptive branching through a mixture; AB-MCTS-A aggregates observations through Gaussian or Beta conjugate models. Neither adds human step labels, a learned judge, or a process reward model. Its feedback remains the task evaluator: public test fraction, ARC demonstration accuracy, or MLE validation score.

For data curation, the important novelty is the distinction between trace-generating capability and trace release. The official code supports full MCTSResult tree serialization and per-call request/response logging, so it defines a strong capture schema for future releases. Yet the published artifacts stop before distributing the realized experimental instances. This makes AB-MCTS both a search recipe and a useful audit case: open algorithms, aggregate tree figures, and selected answers are not equivalent to releasing every generated node and its feedback lineage.

Novelty should not be extended beyond the evidence. The method does not establish a new training objective, a new benchmark, a public trace dataset, explicit failure pruning, or a general theorem that deeper/wider adaptation is optimal. Its empirical contribution is limited to the tested benchmark surfaces, model APIs, evaluators, and nominal generation-call budgets.

AB-MCTS 把分支选择从固定搜索超参数改写为在线预算分配问题。独立 best-of-\(N\) 采样把每次调用都花在宽度上；迭代修订把调用用于深度；standard fixed-branching MCTS 预先规定 expansion 生成多少子节点。AB-MCTS 则让 GEN 选项持续同已有回答路径竞争，并由 Bayesian Thompson sampling 决定下一次调用是打开新回答，还是修订先前回答。

响应树表示对推理数据分析同样重要。非根边不只是抽象搜索转移：它把一个完整回答连接到另一个完整回答，后者由任务、先前响应和 evaluator 反馈共同条件化生成。因此，一棵树可以在同一对象中编码替代尝试与明确修订谱系。只要本地 artifact 得到保留，树宽与修订深度的分离就使分配策略、生成预算、evaluator 结果和最终选择能够在节点级审计。

两个变体改变的是建模方式，而不是引入新的监督来源。AB-MCTS-M 通过 mixture 建模自适应分支；AB-MCTS-A 通过 Gaussian 或 Beta 共轭模型聚合观测。二者都没有添加人工步骤标签、学习式 judge 或 process reward model。反馈仍来自任务 evaluator：公开测试通过比例、ARC demonstration accuracy 或 MLE validation score。

对数据策展而言，关键新意在于区分轨迹生成能力与轨迹发布。官方代码支持完整 MCTSResult 树序列化和逐调用请求/响应日志，因此为未来发布定义了较强的捕获 schema；但已发布 artifact 并未分发实际实验样本。这使 AB-MCTS 同时成为搜索配方和审计案例：开放算法、汇总树图和选中答案，不等于发布每个生成节点及其反馈谱系。

不应把新意扩大到证据之外。该方法没有建立新的训练目标、新 benchmark、公开轨迹数据集、显式失败剪枝，也没有给出“自适应变深/变宽普遍最优”的一般定理。其实证贡献限于已测试 benchmark surface、模型 API、evaluator 和名义生成调用预算。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
Feedback mismatch and verifier scope. Search sees public code tests, ARC demonstrations, or an MLE validation split, while final success uses hidden tests or held-out outputs. Repeated search can overfit these visible surfaces. A high node score does not prove hidden correctness, and none of the evaluators validates intermediate reasoning, causal faithfulness, or semantic quality. ARC-AGI-2 Pass@k says that some branch discovered an exact solution; it does not prove that a deployable selector will choose it.

No released raw trace corpus. The paper-run response trees are not public. Missing objects include the exact task-to-run manifest, every generated answer, parent/child edges as realized, widen/deepen choices and generation order, evaluator payloads, node scores and backups, model-call responses, token/price usage, and final selection history. Unselected branches are especially important: no explicit pruning/deletion path was found, so the implementation can retain them locally, but the public release contains neither all branches nor the rejected/non-winning subset. Aggregate figures and example trees do not support record-level replay.

Model and API drift. GPT-4o is pinned to gpt-4o-2024-08-06, but main DeepSeek-V3 calls use the mutable deepseek-chat alias. The exact served revision, provider-side implementation, retry behavior, and any later endpoint drift are unknown. ARC-AGI-2 names gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06, o4-mini-2025-04-16, and deepseek-r1-0528, but reproducing model behavior can still depend on provider infrastructure and unavailable historical endpoints.

Budget comparability. Counting one generated node as one API call hides completion length, context growth along revision chains, evaluator runtime, parallelism, retries, wall-clock time, and monetary cost. MLE candidates additionally run on one H100 with a one-hour limit. Main results use up to 128 calls, appendix ARC-AGI can use 512 nodes, and ARC-AGI-2 uses 250 calls; collapsing these into one “search budget” would misstate the protocols. TreeQuest also warns that large asynchronous batches can bias the tree toward wider shapes.

Stochasticity and coverage. Temperatures are non-zero, but replication is uneven: five runs for LiveCodeBench, three for CodeContest and ARC-AGI, and one for MLE-Bench. The benchmark families all expose executable or scalar feedback; transfer to open-ended reasoning, subjective judgment, safety tasks, long-horizon agents, or settings without a cheap evaluator remains unknown. External evaluators can also be unavailable or more expensive than generation, an assumption acknowledged by the paper.

Contamination, splits, and rights. Restricting LiveCodeBench to August–November 2024 is a documented contamination precaution, not a comprehensive audit of model training overlap, benchmark cross-overlap, or generated traces. Code search feedback uses public tests, MLE uses an internal 80/20 split, and ARC uses demonstrations, so partition integrity must be preserved in reproduction. TreeQuest and the ARC-AGI-2 repository are Apache-2.0, but that license does not grant rights to benchmark prompts, Kaggle-derived data, model responses, or provider logs. The NeurIPS supplemental experiment bundle has no verified root license; its reuse terms remain unknown.

Release and reproduction status. The entry remains partial, not because the citation is weak, but because code-level capability is much stronger than instance-level disclosure. Direct trace reuse, independent score-history audit, stable API reproduction, and supplemental redistribution remain blocked by the missing raw trees, paper-run logs, model revision pin, and supplemental license.

反馈错配与 verifier 范围。 搜索看到公开代码测试、ARC demonstrations 或 MLE validation split，而最终成功由隐藏测试或 held-out output 判断。重复搜索可能过拟合这些可见 surface。高节点分数不证明隐藏正确性，任何 evaluator 也不验证中间推理、因果忠实性或语义质量。ARC-AGI-2 Pass@k 表示某个分支发现了精确解，却不证明可部署 selector 会选中它。

未发布原始轨迹语料。 论文运行的响应树没有公开。缺失对象包括精确任务—运行清单、每个生成回答、实际父子边、变宽/变深选择与生成顺序、evaluator payload、节点分数及回传、模型调用响应、token/价格用量和最终选择历史。未选分支尤其重要：已检查实现中没有发现显式剪枝/删除路径，因此可以在本地保留它们；但公共发布既不含全部分支，也不含被拒绝/未胜出的子集。汇总图与示例树无法支持记录级重放。

模型与 API 漂移。 GPT-4o 固定为 gpt-4o-2024-08-06，主实验 DeepSeek-V3 却通过可变 deepseek-chat alias 调用。实际服务版本、provider-side 实现、重试行为及后续 endpoint 漂移均为 unknown。ARC-AGI-2 明确命名 gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06、o4-mini-2025-04-16 和 deepseek-r1-0528，但模型行为复现仍可能依赖 provider 基础设施与已下线的历史 endpoint。

预算可比性。 把一个生成节点计为一次 API call，会隐藏 completion 长度、修订链的 context 增长、evaluator 运行时间、并行度、重试、墙钟时间和金钱成本。MLE 候选还要在一张 H100 上运行，时限一小时。主结果最多使用 128 次调用，附录 ARC-AGI 可用 512 个节点，ARC-AGI-2 使用 250 次调用；将这些压缩成同一个“搜索预算”会错误描述协议。TreeQuest 还提示，大型异步 batch 可能让树偏向更宽形态。

随机性与覆盖面。 temperature 非零，但重复次数不均：LiveCodeBench 五次，CodeContest 与 ARC-AGI 三次，MLE-Bench 一次。所用 benchmark 都能提供可执行或标量反馈；对开放式推理、主观判断、安全任务、长程 agent 或缺少廉价 evaluator 的设置能否迁移仍为 unknown。外部 evaluator 也可能不可用，或比生成更昂贵；论文自身承认这一假设限制。

污染、切分与权利。 将 LiveCodeBench 限定在 2024 年 8–11 月，是有记录的污染预防措施，而不是对模型训练重叠、benchmark 交叉重叠或生成轨迹的全面审计。代码搜索反馈使用公开测试，MLE 使用内部 80/20 切分，ARC 使用 demonstrations，因此复现时必须保持 partition integrity。TreeQuest 与 ARC-AGI-2 仓库采用 Apache-2.0，但该许可不授予 benchmark prompt、Kaggle-derived data、模型响应或 provider 日志的权利。NeurIPS supplemental experiment bundle 没有核验到根许可证，其复用条款为 unknown。

发布与复现状态。 条目保持 partial，不是因为引用证据薄弱，而是因为代码级能力远强于实例级披露。缺失原始树、论文运行日志、模型版本固定与 supplemental license，使直接轨迹复用、独立分数历史审计、稳定 API 复现和 supplemental 再分发仍受阻。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, AB-MCTS is a concrete recipe for treating inference budget allocation as a data-construction variable. A follow-up can hold prompts, model snapshot, evaluator, temperature, and total generation calls fixed, then compare independent width, iterative depth, fixed-branch MCTS, AB-MCTS-M, and AB-MCTS-A. The resulting unit of analysis is the full response–revision tree, not only the submitted answer.

Practical uses include:

  • implementing an adaptive widen/deepen generator for code, ARC, or ML-engineering tasks with scalar environmental feedback;
  • serializing MCTSResult trees and per-call logs to build the raw trace release absent from the official artifacts;
  • studying which prompts favor independent alternatives versus feedback-conditioned repair, and how posterior uncertainty moves budget between them;
  • auditing public-feedback overfitting by retaining both search scores and hidden-evaluation outcomes without leaking hidden tests into generation;
  • comparing budgets at matched API calls, generated tokens, wall-clock time, evaluator runtime, and monetary cost;
  • evaluating final-answer selectors separately from Pass@k discovery, especially when a correct branch exists but is not ranked first.

For dataset construction, a minimally useful record should contain the immutable task/source ID, prompt, model snapshot and provider settings, tree node ID, parent ID, fresh-versus-revision action, prior response and feedback context, generated completion, evaluator version and payload, scalar score, visit/value statistics, call order, token and cost accounting, final selection flag, and hidden outcome stored behind a leakage-safe boundary. All nodes should be retained because the checked implementation has no explicit pruning path; an unselected branch is valuable negative or alternative evidence even when it is not the final answer.

For post-training, these trees could later support SFT on successful revisions, preference construction, value modeling, or process studies, but the paper does not perform or validate those uses. They are research opportunities, not evidence-backed training_use labels for this Card. The supported uses remain test_time_compute and evaluation.

The appropriate reuse class is strong inference recipe and capture-schema reference; conditional reproduction; direct trace-data reuse unavailable. TreeQuest can be reused under Apache-2.0 subject to dependency and provider terms, while the benchmark inputs, model responses, ARC-AGI-2 materials, and supplemental bundle require their own rights review. Reproduction should pin the exact model snapshot wherever possible, record the unresolved deepseek-chat revision, keep the main 128-call and ARC-AGI-2 250-call protocols separate, and publish complete trees plus rejected/unselected branches.

The Card also provides a release checklist for the assigned track: runnable search code is not enough. A reusable test-time trace release needs realized raw trees, all model responses, revision prompts, evaluator outputs, branch-selection history, cost accounting, model/version pins, split and contamination documentation, and explicit licenses.

对于 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data，AB-MCTS 提供了把推理预算分配视为数据构造变量的具体配方。后续研究可以固定 prompt、模型快照、evaluator、temperature 和总生成调用数，再比较独立变宽、迭代变深、固定分支 MCTS、AB-MCTS-M 与 AB-MCTS-A。分析单位应是完整响应—修订树，而不只是提交答案。

具体用途包括：

  • 为具有标量环境反馈的代码、ARC 或 ML-engineering 任务实现自适应变宽/变深生成器；
  • 序列化 MCTSResult 树和逐调用日志，构建官方 artifact 缺失的原始轨迹发布；
  • 研究哪些 prompt 更适合独立替代方案，哪些更适合反馈驱动修补，以及后验不确定性如何在二者之间移动预算；
  • 同时保留搜索分数与隐藏评估结果，并阻止隐藏测试泄漏进生成，以审计对公开反馈的过拟合；
  • 在 API 调用数、生成 token、墙钟时间、evaluator 运行时间和金钱成本匹配时比较预算；
  • 将最终答案 selector 与 Pass@k discovery 分开评估，尤其关注树中存在正确分支但排名不在首位的情形。

对于数据集构造，一条最低可用记录应包含不可变任务/来源 ID、prompt、模型快照与 provider 设置、树节点 ID、父节点 ID、新生成或修订动作、先前回答与反馈上下文、生成 completion、evaluator 版本与 payload、标量分数、访问/价值统计、调用顺序、token 与成本计量、最终选择标志，以及在防泄漏边界之后保存的隐藏结果。由于已检查实现中没有显式剪枝路径，应保留全部节点；未选分支即使不是最终答案，也具有负例或替代证据价值。

在后训练方面，这些树未来可以支持对成功修订做 SFT、构造偏好、训练价值模型或开展过程研究，但论文没有执行或验证这些用途。它们是研究机会，不是本 Card 的证据支持型 training_use 标签；这里支持的用途仍只有 test_time_compute 与 evaluation。

适当的复用等级是：强推理配方与捕获 schema 参考；有条件复现；无法直接复用轨迹数据。TreeQuest 可在 Apache-2.0 下复用，但仍受依赖与 provider 条款约束；benchmark 输入、模型响应、ARC-AGI-2 材料和 supplemental bundle 各自需要权利审查。复现应尽可能固定精确模型快照，记录未解决的 deepseek-chat revision，严格区分主实验 128 次调用与 ARC-AGI-2 的 250 次调用协议，并发布完整树及被拒绝/未选分支。

本 Card 也为所分配 track 提供发布清单：可运行搜索代码还不够。可复用测试时轨迹发布需要实际原始树、全部模型响应、修订提示、evaluator 输出、分支选择历史、成本计量、模型/版本固定、切分与污染文档，以及明确许可证。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Sections 3.1–3.4, Algorithm 1, and Appendix A together: the root is a prompt container, every expansion adds one complete scored answer, and Thompson sampling chooses between a fresh GEN branch and traversal toward feedback-conditioned revision.
  • Keep the budgets separate: the main protocol caps generation at 128 API calls per task, extended ARC-AGI analysis reaches 512 nodes, and the later ARC-AGI-2 multi-model experiment uses 250 calls.
  • Pair benchmark curves with the feedback contract: public tests, ARC demonstrations, or MLE validation metrics guide search, while hidden tests or held-out outputs determine final success; search score is not ground-truth process quality.
  • Inspect the supplemental MCTSResult, Node, solver, and OpenAI-compatible logging code to understand what can be preserved locally; then note that the public release contains none of the realized paper-run trees, all responses, unselected branches, or API logs.
  • Before reproduction or reuse, pin model revisions, preserve complete trees without inventing a pruning stage, report tokens/evaluator/wall-clock costs in addition to calls, and resolve benchmark rights plus the unknown supplemental-bundle license.

• 应把第 3.1–3.4 节、算法 1 与附录 A 连起来阅读：根节点是提示容器，每次 expansion 增加一个完整且已评分的答案，Thompson sampling 在全新 GEN 分支和通向反馈驱动修订的遍历之间选择。
  • 必须分开预算：主协议每个任务最多 128 次生成 API call，扩展 ARC-AGI 分析达到 512 个节点，较后的 ARC-AGI-2 多模型实验使用 250 次调用。
  • 阅读 benchmark 曲线时应同时检查反馈契约：公开测试、ARC demonstrations 或 MLE validation metric 引导搜索，隐藏测试或 held-out output 决定最终成功；搜索分数不是过程质量真值。
  • 应检查 supplemental 中的 MCTSResult、Node、solver 与 OpenAI-compatible 日志代码，理解本地可以保留什么；随后确认公共发布没有实际论文运行树、全部回答、未选分支或 API 日志。
  • 复现或复用前，应固定模型版本，保留完整树且不要虚构剪枝阶段，除调用数外报告 token/evaluator/墙钟成本，并解决 benchmark 权利与 unknown 的 supplemental-bundle license。

value.html: CodeContest; LiveCodeBench release-v4 problems dated August-November 2024; 100 public ARC-AGI evaluation problems and prompts used by prior work; three low-complexity MLE-Bench Kaggle-derived tasks; and, in the extended study, the 120-task ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation set.

Each non-root search node holds a complete generated Python solution or ML-engineering program; a deep child is a feedback-conditioned revision of its parent response, while a wide child is a new sample.
GPT-4o, DeepSeek-V3, and, in the ARC-AGI-2 extension, Gemini 2.5 Pro, o4-mini, and DeepSeek-R1-0528.
Python code execution against public tests, ARC demonstration examples, or MLE validation splits supplies search-time feedback; hidden tests or held-out ARC outputs provide final evaluation.

CodeContest and LiveCodeBench use the fraction of public tests passed; ARC uses the fraction of demonstration transformations solved; MLE-Bench uses task-specific validation metrics. These are search surrogates, not guaranteed hidden-test correctness.

Search stops at the configured generation-call budget and selects a top-scoring valid node for final hidden evaluation; ARC-AGI-2 additionally reports Pass@k over whether any branch finds an exact solution.

GPT-4o (gpt-4o-2024-08-06) and DeepSeek-V3 (deepseek-chat) in the main experiments; Gemini 2.5 Pro (gemini-2.5-pro-preview-05-06), o4-mini (o4-mini-2025-04-16), and DeepSeek-R1-0528 (deepseek-r1-0528) in the multi-LLM ARC-AGI-2 extension.
unknown

AB-MCTS adds one answer node per expansion and uses Thompson sampling over Bayesian posterior predictives to decide between a new GEN branch and traversal toward a feedback-conditioned refinement. AB-MCTS-M uses mixed models; AB-MCTS-A uses aggregated Gaussian or Beta node models.

Main experiments run at non-zero temperature with five repetitions for LiveCodeBench, three for CodeContest and ARC-AGI, and one for MLE-Bench. Public feedback is appended to the parent response before a deep revision call.

One generated response per non-root search node; maximum 128 generation/API calls per task in the main experiments and 250 calls for the ARC-AGI-2 extension. Realized paper-run trees are not released.
0.6 for GPT-4o and 1.0 for DeepSeek-V3 in the main experiments; 0.6 for all ARC-AGI-2 extension models.

No generation-time branch is explicitly pruned in the checked implementation. All nodes remain in the local tree; final submission code ranks nodes and chooses the highest-ranked response with valid Python code, while hidden tests are reserved for evaluation.

Main maximum is 128 LLM generation/API calls per task; standard MCTS uses five children per expansion and a final three-child expansion to hit 128 exactly. Appendix analyses reach 512 nodes for extended ARC-AGI, and ARC-AGI-2 uses 250 calls.
AB-MCTS-M mixed-model Thompson sampling, AB-MCTS-A Gaussian/Beta node-aggregation Thompson sampling, and AIDE for MLE-Bench. This is an inference scaffold, not a post-training optimizer.

Four main benchmark families are combined only for evaluation, not as a training mixture. Prompt and task rights remain governed by CodeContest, LiveCodeBench, ARC-AGI, MLE-Bench, Kaggle, and provider terms; the work does not release a consolidated prompt corpus.

Code benchmarks use public tests for search feedback and hidden tests for final evaluation. MLE-Bench randomly splits training data 80/20 for training/validation and evaluates the chosen node on hidden test data. ARC uses demonstration examples for search feedback and held-out test outputs for exact-match evaluation.
LiveCodeBench is restricted to August-November 2024 problems as a stated contamination precaution; broader cross-benchmark, model-training, and generated-trace decontamination is unknown.

items: Public-test, demonstration, or validation feedback can overfit the search and disagree with hidden-test correctness.
The main DeepSeek-V3 endpoint is recorded only as the mutable deepseek-chat alias, so the exact served model revision is not reproducible.
API-call/node count ignores token volume, wall-clock time, evaluator execution cost, retries, and task-specific GPU use.
Pass@k on ARC-AGI-2 measures whether any branch discovers a solution and does not solve the final-answer selection problem.
TreeQuest notes that large asynchronous batches can bias the tree toward wider shapes.
Realized raw trees, all responses, unselected branches, and paper-run API logs are not released, preventing direct trace-level audit or reuse.
